question_or_proposition: Whether the prohibition on discharge of floating solids or visible foam 'in other than trace amounts' establishes an enforceable numeric discharge limit subject to numeric exceedance comparison, or instead establishes a qualitative effluent limitation whose compliance depends on whether observable discharge exceeds 'trace amounts'.
required_context: Part I.A section 'FLOATING SOLIDS, VISIBLE FOAM AND/OR OILS', including the adjacent narrative limits on visible oil films, globules, grease, solids, and stream-bank coatings
Sampling location requirement that compliance samples must be taken at the discharge after the treatment system and prior to the receiving stream
notes: Interpretation determines whether Purpose A treats floating solids/visible foam as parameters with applicable numeric limits or as non-numeric limits excluded from numeric exceedance comparison, and whether Purpose C can classify no-result monitoring periods for these parameters as assessable qualitative expectations versus unresolved applicability.
